source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / ASPIRE Project, IFAD-funded - "បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះក្រូចថ្លុងដែលធន់ទៅនឹងការប្រែប្រួលអាកាសធាតុ / Climate Resilience Pomelo Growing Technique", Nov 2018, 17pp
text:
Planting material is produced from cuttings/marcots (ការជ្រើសរើសដើម) taken from healthy mother trees, following essentially the same air-layering approach described in the general pomelo manual: a section of a healthy branch is wrapped with a moist rooting medium in plastic, secured at both ends, and left until roots form, after which the marcot is cut and potted for hardening off.

The guide emphasizes selecting only vigorous, disease-free, true-to-type mother trees for cutting material, since the productivity and climate resilience of the whole future orchard depends on the quality of the planting stock chosen at this stage.
